children: Bitcoin remains under pressure in the morning Asia session as fresh AI jitters and Fed rate-hike bets keep sentiment in the crypto market risk-off. Bitcoin's tentative rebound has faltered in the face of worries about tighter regulation in the U.S., continued ETF outflows and heightened expectations of tighter monetary policy at the Fed after CPI surprised to the upside. Beyond the U.S., several major central banks are expected to keep monetary policy restrictive in the coming months as inflation pressures persist, says Mahmoud Mashal at VT Markets Dubai. That paints a bullish outlook for global yields, dimming the appeal of riskier assets such as cryptocurrencies, the senior analyst says. Bitcoin falls 0.9% to $73,633, LSEG data show, well below the psychological $75,000 mark. (fabiana.negrinochoa@wsj.com)
